verdicts.reason: A is basically the original scaled down. The white card shrinks, so the logo wordmark, the NOW OPEN eyebrow and the body copy become tiny and hard to read. Nothing is rearranged for the shorter canvas, and the orphaned word 'entry.' remains. B actually reflows into a left-to-right banner: big headline, readable body and a clear CTA on the right. However, NOW OPEN has dropped below the body copy, which breaks the reading order. The GALLERY wordmark sits on the dark diagonal band with poor contrast. A thin image sliver is left at the right edge, and 'entry.' is still orphaned.
